[2026 Women's PGA Championship] The 2026 KPMG Women's PGA Championship is the 72nd Women's PGA Championship. It is being played June 25–28 at Hazeltine National Golf Club in Chaska, Minnesota. Hazeltine previously hosted the Women's PGA Championship in 2019, won by Hannah Green. It also hosted the U.S. Women's Open in 1966 and 1977. The PGA Championship was the third of five major championships on the LPGA Tour during the 2026 season. Ryu Hae-ran won her first major championship by two strokes over Ina Yoon. | other articles: Ryu Hae-ran, 2026 Women's British Open
